common.allUpToDate: All installed tools are up to date.

filter.noMatchBody: No rows match the current filter. Edit or clear the filter to bring the full list back.

banner.label: Untrusted config
banner.body: This directory's mise.toml has not been trusted. Env and tasks will not run until you trust it.

trust.ok: Trusted. You may need to re-run actions to see updated results.
trust.error: Could not trust the directory. Check the execution panel for details.

home.title: Home
home.hint: Is mise installed and new enough for MiseDeck? Guided install and self-update live here; every action streams through the execution panel.

tools.title: Tools
tools.hint: Tools installed and active for the current directory. Switch versions, install, uninstall, or upgrade from the table; every mutation streams through the execution panel.
tools.commandHint: mise ls · mise outdated · mise use · mise upgrade · mise uninstall · mise install · mise link · mise ls-remote

empty.title: No tools installed
empty.body: Install your first tool with the form below, or browse the Registry on the Plugins page.

missing.title: Tools unavailable
missing.body: MiseDeck needs the mise CLI to list installed tools. Go back and install mise to populate this page.

error.title: Failed to load tools
error.body: `mise ls --json` did not return. Stderr is preserved in the execution panel.

linkForm.title: Link a tool
linkForm.explanation: Link adopts a directory you built locally as an installed version instead of downloading one: `mise link <tool>@<version> <path>` symlinks it into mise.
linkForm.duplicateVersion: {{tool}}@{{version}} already exists. Uninstall it first, then link again.

installed.title: Installed versions
installed.emptyBody: `mise ls <tool>` lists every installed version — active and inactive. Run it above to query a tool.

remote.title: Remote versions
remote.emptyBody: `mise ls-remote <tool>` lists versions available upstream. Run it above to query a tool.

uninstall.title: Uninstall {{tool}}?
uninstall.body: This will run the exact command below. The selected version will be removed and this cannot be undone.

preview.title: Directory overview
preview.hint: Resolved tools, env, config files, and lockfile for the current directory.
preview.commandHint: mise -C <dir> ls · mise outdated · mise trust · mise env · mise config · mise.lock

empty.body: The env, config, and lockfile sections already show the global resolution; this list is directory-scoped. Choose a directory to see what `mise -C <dir> ls` reports there.

config.orderNote: In precedence order, highest first — the same order `mise config ls --json` reports.
config.empty: `mise config ls` found no config files in scope for the current directory.
config.errorBody: `mise config ls --json` did not return. Stderr is preserved in the execution panel.

env.emptyBody: `mise env --json` returned an empty map. Add an [env] table to a mise config file in scope to surface values here.
env.errorBody: `mise env --json` did not return. Stderr is preserved in the execution panel.

toolsError.title: Failed to load resolved tools
toolsError.body: `mise -C <dir> ls --json` did not return. Stderr is preserved in the execution panel.

lockfile.title: mise.lock
lockfile.errorBody: MiseDeck could not read the current directory's mise.lock. Stderr is preserved in the execution panel.

env.title: Env
env.hint: Resolved environment variables for the current directory. Add, edit, or remove vars; every write goes through `mise set` / `mise unset` and streams into the panel.
env.commandHint: mise env --json-extended · mise set · mise unset

empty.title: No env vars
empty.body: `mise env --json-extended` returned an empty map. Use the form below to add your first env var; writes go to mise's config file for the current directory.

error.title: Failed to load env vars
error.body: `mise env --json-extended` did not return. Stderr is preserved in the execution panel.

guard.untrustedBody: Trust this directory before mutating its env vars.

tooltip.tool: Injected by {{tool}} via `mise env`; resolved at runtime, not settable via `mise set`.
tooltip.default: Inherited from the host environment; not written by mise, so not settable via `mise set`.

remove.title: Remove {{name}}?
remove.body: This will run the exact command below. The env var will be removed from mise's config for this context and this cannot be undone.

tasks.title: Tasks
tasks.subtitle: List, run, and edit the mise tasks for the active directory. Writes go through `mise tasks add` and stream into the panel.
tasks.commandHint: mise tasks ls · mise run · mise tasks add · mise tasks edit --path

empty.title: No tasks
empty.body: `mise tasks ls` returned no tasks here. Tasks come from the `[tasks]` table of a mise.toml in scope, or from executable files under `mise-tasks/`.

editForm.title: Edit task
editForm.dependsHelp: Each name is a task in the current directory's `mise.toml`. Separate with commas.

guard.untrustedBody: Trust this directory before mutating its tasks.

openEditorError.title: Could not open the config file
openEditorError.body: `mise tasks edit --path` did not return a usable path. Stderr is preserved in the execution panel.

openConfigError.body: `mise config ls --json` did not return a config file to open. Stderr is preserved in the execution panel.

readError.title: Failed to load tasks
readError.body: `mise tasks ls --json` did not return. Stderr is preserved in the execution panel.

settings.title: Settings
settings.hint: View and edit mise settings for the current directory. Writes go through `mise settings set` / `mise settings unset` and stream into the panel.
settings.commandHint: mise settings ls · mise settings set · mise settings unset

empty.title: No settings configured
empty.body: `mise settings ls --json-extended` populates this list. Use the form below to add one.

error.title: Failed to load settings
error.body: `mise settings ls --json-extended` did not return. Stderr is preserved in the execution panel.

guard.untrustedBody: Trust this directory before mutating its settings.

doctor.title: Doctor
doctor.hint: A health check for the current directory's mise setup. When `--json` is unavailable, the raw doctor output is rendered with row tinting.

toolset.title: Resolved toolset
toolset.emptyBody: `mise doctor --json` reported an empty toolset for the current directory.

error.title: Failed to load doctor
error.body: `mise doctor --json` did not return. Stderr is preserved in the execution panel.

updateNotice.title: Update available
updateNotice.framing: A new mise release is available.

plugins.title: Plugins
plugins.hint: Installed plugins and the built-in registry of tool shorthands, backends, and aliases.

uninstall.title: Uninstall {{name}}?
uninstall.body: This will run the exact command below. The plugin will be removed and this cannot be undone.

installedEmpty.title: No plugins installed
installedEmpty.body: `mise plugins ls` returned an empty list.

installedError.title: Failed to load plugins
installedError.body: `mise plugins ls` did not return. Stderr is preserved in the execution panel.

empty.title: No registry entries
empty.searchBody: No registry entry matches your search.

error.title: Failed to load registry
error.body: `mise registry --json` did not return. Stderr is preserved in the execution panel.

notInstalled.title: mise not found
notInstalled.body: We could not locate the mise binary on this machine. Install it from {{url}} and relaunch MiseDeck.

tooOld.title: mise is too old
tooOld.body: Found {{found}}, but MiseDeck requires at least {{minimum}}. Update with `mise self-update`.

commandFailed.title: mise failed
commandFailed.body: `mise version --json` exited with a non-zero status. Stderr is preserved in the execution panel.

parseFailed.title: unrecognised mise response
parseFailed.body: MiseDeck could not parse `mise version --json`. You may be running a forked build.

errors.miseNotFound: The mise CLI was not found on this machine. Install it from https://mise.jdx.dev/installing.html and relaunch MiseDeck.
errors.miseTooOld: Found mise {{found}}, but MiseDeck requires at least {{minimum}}. Run `mise self-update` to upgrade.
errors.terminalNotFound: No terminal emulator was found on this Linux system (looked for gnome-terminal, konsole, xfce4-terminal).
errors.timeout: mise did not respond within the timeout.
errors.unknown: Something went wrong. The execution panel has the details.

execution.title: Execution
execution.copyHint: Copy the exact command to your clipboard
execution.emptyHint: No command has been run yet.

activation.openInTerminalError: Could not open a terminal at {{path}}. Copy the command and run it yourself.
activation.bannerBody: Your {{shell}} config at {{rcPath}} does not have `mise activate`. Add the line below so mise can manage your shell's tools.
activation.bannerBodyUnknownShell: MiseDeck could not detect your shell ({{name}}). Add the appropriate `mise activate <shell>` line to your shell's rc file to use mise in interactive sessions.
